blocks.text: Margin collapse is when two margins collapse into a single margin.

Top and bottom margins of elements are sometimes collapsed into a single
margin that is equal to the largest of the two margins.

Note: Margin collapse only happens with top and bottom
margins! Not left and right margins!

In the following example, the <h1> element has a bottom margin of 50px and
the <h2> element has a top margin of 20px. So, the vertical margin between the
<h1> and the <h2> would be a total of 70px (50px + 20px). But due to margin
collapse, the actual margin ends up being 50px:
